name: VFX Weaver API
description: A client-side VFX library/API for Minecraft: ping-pong FBO post-processing (chromatic aberration, color grading, distortion, dent, gradient map, posterize, blur, pixelate, hue isolation, vignette, screen flash, motion blur, speed lines), camera shake, block tint/outline overlays, entity tint/outline by UUID, keyframe animation, world/camera/player bindings, datapack-defined effects, sound triggers and a public Java API.
